description: $0.01 per page. Use when you need who bought and sold ONE pump.fun token trade by trade, or to poll its new trades: every bonding-curve buy and sell in slot order, up to 500 per page (time, slot, signature, wallet, side, SOL, tokens, whether it was the wallet's first buy, its label, running net SOL in), a summary of the last 60 s and 5 min, a demand block (wash trading vs organic volume) and the cohorts block (with the holders' reputation across tokens) on every page. Input: mint (a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link), optional since (next_cursor, a slot or unix seconds; omitted = from launch), limit. Pass next_cursor back as since; no new trade after since, an uncovered mint or a stale feed is refused before payment. Who holds it now: mint_holders.
